type: Engineering Style Technical Mind Map (Radial Mind Map)
goal: Create a mind map of frontend engineer skills with a dark grid background, emphasizing TypeScript/browser platform at the center, with six main branches, consistently colored for sub-nodes, using mono fixed-width small cards.

canvas.background: deep slate #0F172A with subtle 1px grid #1E293B at 32px spacing

title_strip.title: Web front-end capability map (delivery level)
title_strip.subtitle: TypeScript priority · 2026
title_strip.position: top-left, JetBrains Mono / SF Mono, light gray

branch_node_style.label: mono bold 13pt, centered, light text
branch_node_style.position: evenly distributed around central node, ~ radius 380-440px

primary_branches.connector_style: thick branch-colored line 2px from central node to primary node, slight curve

secondary_nodes.rule: Each primary hangs 4-6 secondary, branching out along the main branch direction

B1: Platform API (Fetch, BroadcastChannel, File System Access permission model)
B2: Cross-platform: React Native new architecture / Expo SDK 53
B4: ESLint 9 flat config + TypeScript-ESLint strict set
B6: Core Web Vitals: Prioritize INP, Split Long Tasks

secondary_nodes.connector_style: thin branch-colored line 1.2px from primary to secondary, curved

tertiary_nodes.rule: No expansion of the third layer to avoid crowding; if the center of the canvas still appears empty, you can point out the zod mode under B3's tRPC

must_know.rule: Add ★ and bold 2.5px border to the three items: '★ TypeScript 5.6', '★ React 19 / Next', '★ OpenTelemetry browser + RUM'

legend.content: branch color → six major domains; star → job hard thresholds; line thickness → primary / secondary level

must_keep: The central node is unique, centered, and has the largest font size.
Each main branch is one color all the way through
Monospaced font, dark fine grid, clear hierarchy of nodes large, medium, small
Radiate evenly, avoiding crowding in the upper right quadrant.
avoid: Use emoji as node main icon
Claims to be XMind file that can be opened
